exposure: Number of previous cesarean sections (one vs. two)
outcome: Breastfeeding rate in the first 48 hours
cohort: This study included 339 pregnant women with a history of one or two previous cesarean sections in Mashhad, Iran.
finding: TOLAC has a high success rate (94.1%) and similar maternal and neonatal outcomes for women with one or two previous cesarean sections.
